page0.text:
"Sakura..."
"...her. I killed her. She loved me so much, and I killed...my...sister..."

page1.text:
Sakura isn't talking to me.
She's in denial.
She did this.
In a near-craze, she hates herself with all her heart—herself for soaking in Tohsaka's blood, herself for being corrupted, herself for connecting to the Shadow.

page2.text: "I was a fool. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. It was just so painful. She told me not to, always told me not to lose, but I didn't understand because I'm stupid, and Senpai believed in me, but I keep betraying—"

page3.text:
The shadow binds Sakura.
The black Command Spells covering her whole body chain her in place.

page4.text: "No more... I have to stop this...but I can't...take it back...No more... I don't want to do this anymore!"

page5.text:
She refuses.
Sakura is rejecting the Shadow.
She's trying to reject the Shadow and kill herself in her self-hatred.

page6.text:
But she can't.
The Shadow needs her body.
She's trying to kill herself, but the Shadow won't allow it.
Sakura's self-condemnation and the Shadow's attempt to stop her from killing herself are tearing her apart.

page7.text:
...
...Tohsaka won.
Sakura's breaking free of her possession.
I knew it. She chose Sakura's life in the very end.

page8.text:
Sakura is Sakura.
Even if the Shadow swallows her, she hasn't changed at her core.
...I'm the one who did this to her.
Back then... If I hadn't been afraid of the shadow-touched Sakura and slapped some sense into her, this never would've happened.

page9.text:
"......Ngh."
I run to Tohsaka.
She's still breathing, just barely.
It's still too early to give up.

page11.text: "That's right. She isn't dead. We can still save her. No, we will save her. You and I need to save her. Isn't that right, Sakura?"

page12.text:
"Ah... Eh?"
Light returns to Sakura's eyes.
The Shadow's hold weakens.

page13.text:
Finally, she recognizes me and Tohsaka, sighs in relief, and...
"...! No! You have to run, Senpai!"
...desperately holds herself back.

page14.text:
"...Ngh!"
I shield Tohsaka with my body and take the Shadow's attack on my back.
"Ah... N-no, that wasn't me, I...!"

page15.text:
Shadows spill out one after another from behind Sakura.
...You've gotta be kidding me.
It's not even born yet, but its sense of danger is first-class.

page16.text:
"I know. It's that sore loser behind you. It doesn't want me to take you, so it's throwing a tantrum.
...Just hang on. I'll give it a good punch and take it away from you."
I walk toward Sakura.

page17.text:
"No... S-stop, Senpai!"
A shadow grazes my cheek.
It would have taken my head off, but Sakura's shout seems to have changed its trajectory.

page18.text:
"Hah...ah, ah, ugh...!"
Sakura hugs herself like she's trying to hold something in.
But the shadows don't disappear. They keep increasing in number.

page19.text:
"Uu...uu...uuu...!"
...She's crying.
Sakura is sobbing.
Not because the shadows are eating at her and causing pain.
She's crying in frustration that she can't keep the shadows under control.

page20.text:
"...Senpai, no. I can't...hold them back. Nee-san warned me, but I lost to them... I wasn't strong at all. I'm a crybaby, a coward, and a horrible person."
I take another step forward.
A shadowy spear grazes my cheek again.

page21.text:
"...! Stop! Why are you coming this way!?
I'll kill you if you get any closer...!"
I take another step.
I place my right hand on my left shoulder.

page22.text:
"Why? Run. Please run away, Senpai! Take Nee-san and get out of here!
You can forget about me...! I'll... I'll make sure I die here! I'll make sure I die all alone! I... I don't want... I don't want you to see me like this, Senpai...!"

page23.text:
The Shadow binds her more strongly with each step I take.
My advance is hurting Sakura's body and heart.

page24.text:
"Why won't you do what I ask you to!?
I-if you come any closer, I won't be able to hold it back. I'll kill you before you can kill me...!"
"That won't happen at all. I'm going to get you out of here and save Tohsaka. I already told you that, Sakura."

page25.text:
"...Are you still saying that, Senpai?
...Please stop. I'm beyond saving. No, I shouldn't be saved. I don't deserve to live."

page26.text:
One step.
"Ngh."
A shadow hits me squarely in the stomach.
...It isn't a stab. It was just a dull punch.
Sakura did it out of her own will, to push me away.

page27.text:
"Did you see that, Senpai? This is who I am now. I can't leave this place anymore, and this child won't let me go.
And...even if I did..."

page28.text:
"...I've killed a lot of people. So many people. I even killed my brother and grandfather, and my sister...!
What's someone like me supposed to do now!? I can't give back what I've taken from them. I've killed too many people. Are you still going to tell me to live despite all that, Senpai!?"

page29.text:
...
...I see now.
She's on a path of no return.
Sakura feels like she's trapped by sins that she can't atone for.

page30.text:
She thinks that there's no salvation.
No matter what, she'll never forget the sin of taking so many lives, even if it wasn't of her own free will.
Even if she's freed from the Shadow and goes back to normal, a different kind of shadow will always hang over her.
And yet...

page31.text: "...Of course I am. You need to take responsibility for what you've done, Sakura."

page32.text:
I release the bindings on my left arm.
This is the last time. I completely unravel the red shroud that's been holding back death's door.

page33.text:
...I lose consciousness.
Before I'm gone, I need to go forward.
I need to say what I came to say to Sakura while my mouth still works.

page34.text:
"Sen...pai."
"Yeah. I don't know who's responsible or how heavy the punishment should be."
"Guh...!"
Shadows strike at my shoulder, chest, left leg, and stomach.
Grinnnnd.
They get deflected and fail to pierce me, throwing up a shower of sparks.

page35.text:
"But I'll protect you. I'll protect you from everything people blame you for.
Even if it's hypocritical, I've always tried to live up to the ideal of protecting the people I love."
Forward.
Sakura's right in front of me now.

page36.text:
"Oh no... Senpai, your body..."
...Begin...Projection.
Only one item comes to mind.
Shirou Emiya devotes all of his remaining magical energy into its replication.

page37.text:
My final Projection.
I raise a dagger of contract-breaking.
I can't see Sakura's face very well.

page38.text:
"Sen...pai."
"This is your punishment. It's gonna hurt, so grit your teeth and bear it."
"..."
I hear her suck in her breath.
And then...
Sakura says, "yes," and exposes her chest.

page39.text: Like this is going to be her final punishment.

page40.text: "Let's go home, Sakura. Cut your ties with that guy."

page41.text: In a breath, I stab her in the heart.
